title: Sculpture Gallery
caption: A daylit museum room you can walk through
blurb: One room of a museum at real scale: a scanned marble bust, two bronzes and a porcelain horse on stone plinths under a glass ceiling, with paintings from The Met on the walls. The light under a chin is daylight that came down through the ceiling and bounced off the parquet; in the evening the room is lit only by what its spots throw back.
